You will read the code reviews, challenge the architecture, understand why a pipeline failed, and set the quality bar yourself. You will also run the commercials, the governance and the executive relationship. We are looking for someone who has done both at once, for a demanding client, and would rather be measured on outcomes than on activity. What you will own Each accountability has a measure. These are how your first six months will be judged.

  

**Accountability**

What good looks like Program ownership Single point of accountability to the client sponsor and the client's core engineering team. Issues escalated to the sponsor that we should have resolved ourselves: zero. Technical leadership Set and enforce the quality bar before anything reaches the client: complete PRs with issue links and validation evidence, a recurring-issue log driven to zero, first-pass review acceptance rising quarter on quarter. Delivery throughput Agree and freeze scope each iteration; deliver at least 90% of committed scope; roughly double dataset import/refresh throughput within two quarters, with cycle time by size tracked against a baseline. Executive reporting Monthly newsletters and the quarterly business review accepted by the sponsor on first draft; pre-reads with our CEO one week out and with the sponsor five days out; one clear message per update; every document opens with a review-and-approval table. Financial discipline Live financials updated by the 2nd of each month, figures agreed by the 5th, invoices closed with evidence by the 5th, every approval on email. Budget burn tracked against the SOW with no surprises. Work visibility 100% of team work logged daily in the client's tracking tools and per-phase time tracking; nothing reaches the client without your review. Team structure A lean, unambiguous org: one owner per role, measurable success criteria for every role, a RACI the client can read in one pass; weekly reviews with a current decision log. Shaping, not following Grow our share of contributions to the client's ingestion and refresh process (tools, agents, validation checks, runbooks), tracked in a contribution register co-signed by the client. Commercial stewardship Own SOW amendments, scope-versus-contract alignment and the scaling model for new custom deployments, with the Client Partner and Finance.

  

**Hands-on experience**

We need You do not need to have done every item, but you must be able to sit with an engineer, open the code and get to the root cause yourself.

* 15+ years in data engineering, platform engineering or technical program leadership, with 5+ years leading programs of $3M+ a year for a demanding enterprise or hyperscaler client.
* Large-scale data ingestion and refresh pipelines: schema design and validation, statistical and time-series data at hundreds of datasets and tens of millions of data points, data provenance and licensing compliance, source qualification, failure triage and root-cause analysis.
* Google Cloud at depth: BigQuery, Spanner, GCS, Cloud Run / GKE, Vertex AI (including embedding models and regional deployment), Looker. GCP Professional Data Engineer or Architect certification preferred.
* Agentic and LLM-assisted engineering: you have put code-review assistants, diagnostic agents or skills frameworks into a real delivery workflow, managed hallucination and prompt-quality issues, and measured the velocity gain. MCP and agent integration into client applications is a strong plus.
* Custom deployments in customer-hosted environments: cloud infrastructure, networking and security reviews, deployment runbooks, embedded UI (iframe, D3 / web components) and conversational agents bolted onto a product.
* Contributing to a client's platform: PRs that improve the product itself (cost analysis, validation, configuration-driven frameworks), reviewed and merged by the client's core team.
* Distributed teams: led 20+ engineers across US and India time zones, with execution leads reporting to you and a technical lead co-located with the client's core team.
* Program governance: iteration planning and scope freezes, RAID, QBRs, SOW and PO management, fixed-fee and T&M billing, velocity and penalty clauses, financial forecasting to the dollar.

  

**How you work**

These traits matter more to us than any single technology. We will test for each in interviews.

* You own outcomes, not tasks. When something goes wrong, your first instinct is “this is mine to fix,” not “this is blocked on the client.” You resolve problems before the sponsor hears about them and tell them what you did, not what you need.
* You get it right the first time. You would rather send one clear page than three drafts. You review every number before it leaves the team, and you treat a report that needs rework as a defect.
* You are hands-on by choice. You read the PRs, you can explain why the pipeline failed, and you set the technical bar by example. Engineers respect you because you can do the work, not because of your title.
* You are relentless about visibility. If work is not in the system, it did not happen. You enforce daily updates, per-phase time tracking and decision logs because you believe in them, not because the client asked.

* You shape rather than follow. You bring proposals to the client's core team, get them adopted, and move the partnership from “executes well” to “co-designs the process.”
* You build lean, clear teams. One owner per role, measurable criteria for every person, no ambiguity about who decides. You give credit by name and hold people to the standard the best of them already meet.
* You are calm under pressure. You have been on a program in code-yellow, turned it around in weeks, and kept the team's confidence while doing it.

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As an Infrastructure Architect, you will serve as a key technical link between Kyndryl and its clients, providing leadership throughout the project lifecycle. You will collaborate with client stakeholders, governance teams, project executives, delivery teams, and vendors to understand business and technical requirements, define appropriate solutions, and ensure successful delivery within agreed timelines and budgets.

  

As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.

  

At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.

**What You Will Do**

  

* Design, implement, manage, and troubleshoot Microsoft Azure infrastructure and application platforms, including Virtual Networks, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, DNS, gateways, App Services, AKS, Azure SQL Server, and Azure SQL Database.
* Develop and maintain automation and CI/CD pipelines using PowerShell, Bash/Shell scripting, Python, Azure DevOps, and YAML for efficient application and infrastructure deployments.
* Build reusable Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using ARM templates and Azure Bicep, ensuring cloud environments are scalable, secure, repeatable, and consistently configured.
* Implement DevOps and DevSecOps best practices, including Desired State Configuration, shift-left security/testing, configuration management, automated validation, monitoring, logging, and cloud security controls.
Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, database, and architecture teams to automate operational processes, troubleshoot complex Azure/AKS/networking issues, improve platform reliability, and maintain technical documentation and runbooks.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Minimum 6+ years of relevant experience in DevOps, Cloud, Platform, or Infrastructure Engineering, with strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure enterprise environments.
* Strong experience with Azure networking, including Virtual Networks, subnets, NSGs, routing, gateways, DNS, network segmentation, private/public connectivity, IP addressing, CIDR, TLS/SSL, and secure network communication.
* Hands-on experience with Azure App Services, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, along with working knowledge of T-SQL and SQL troubleshooting.
* Strong automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) expertise using PowerShell, Bash/Shell, Python, ARM templates, Azure Bicep, and Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for CI/CD and infrastructure deployments.
Solid understanding of DevOps and DevSecOps practices, including Desired State Configuration, shift-left methodologies, cloud security, Git/Azure DevOps Repos, branching, merging, pull requests, code reviews, and strong troubleshooting across applications, pipelines, networking, and cloud infrastructure.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Hands-on experience managing production-grade Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments, Docker/containerization, Azure security controls, Managed Identities, Service Principals, Azure Key Vault, RBAC, and least-privilege access models.
* Experience with Azure monitoring and observability tools such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights, with a strong focus on platform reliability, security, and operational excellence.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code and automation, including reusable Azure Bicep modules, standardized deployment patterns, and clean, scalable, maintainable automation solutions.
* Experience integrating security, quality, and compliance controls into CI/CD pipelines, with knowledge of blue-green, rolling, and canary deployment strategies.
Strong troubleshooting, ownership, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to work effectively in Agile/Scrum environments and collaborate across development, infrastructure, security, database, and architecture teams from solution design through production support.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

* Drive schema design, data modelling, and partitioning strategies that balance query performance against storage cost at petabyte scale.

**Required**

* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years building production data pipelines in Python (Pandas, PySpark, asyncio, or equivalent).
* Deep hands-on experience with AWS data services: S3, Glue, Lambda, Kinesis / MSK, Redshift, RDS, Step Functions.

* Experience designing and operating high-availability, low-latency streaming and batch pipelines in production.
* Proficiency in SQL and data modelling for analytical and operational workloads.
* Familiarity with data quality patterns: schema validation, reconciliation, SLA monitoring, dead-letter queues, and alerting.
* Strong communication skills — you write clear design docs, run productive tech discussions, and collaborate across disciplines.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with securities master / reference data systems: CUSIP, ISIN, SEDOL, FIGI, and corporate action processing.
* Prior integration with major market data vendors (Bloomberg B-PIPE / SAPI, Refinitiv/LSEG Elektron, ICE Data Services).

* Experience with Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or other open table formats for data lake management.
* Familiarity with risk or pricing platforms in asset management or insurance investment operations.
* AWS Professional or Specialty certifications (Data Analytics, Solutions Architect).
